description: This file is a test suite for the Parser class handling event log files in the 'winscope' format. It includes unit tests verifying trace type, timestamps, and specific parsed events like CUJ events.

classes.name: ParserEventLog
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the functionality of the event log parser, specifically for 'traces/eventlog.winscope' files.

classes.name: CujEvent
classes.description: Represents a CUJ (Critical User Journey) event parsed from the trace.

classes.name: RealTimestamp
classes.description: Represents a real timestamp extracted from the trace data.

methods.name: beforeAll
methods.description: Initializes the parser before running tests by loading the eventlog.winscope trace file.

methods.name: it has expected trace type
methods.description: Checks that the parser reports the correct trace type.

methods.name: it has expected timestamps
methods.description: Verifies that the parser correctly extracts timestamps, including specific expected values.

methods.name: it doesn't provide elapsed timestamps
methods.description: Ensures that the parser does not supply elapsed timestamps for this trace.

methods.name: it contains parsed jank CUJ events
methods.description: Confirms that specific entries in the parsed trace are correctly identified as CUJ events.
